page.overview:
Who is Laozi?

Laozi went out to preach the Tao with Dipankara, and when he returned home to the Tushita Heavenly Palace he found that Sun Wukong had eaten his entire supply of Golden Pills of the Nine Transformations.

When the gods had trouble arresting Sun Wukong for his crimes, Laozi threw his Diamond Cutter at Sun Wukong to knock him to the ground, where Erlang Shen and the Six Brothers of Mount Mei were able to capture him.
